item.title: Text-Driven 3D Indoor Scene Synthesis in Non-Manhattan Environments
item.description:
This research solves the problem of generating 3D indoor scenes in non-Manhattan environments, where existing methods often fail to capture plausible object layouts. The researchers built a novel text-driven framework called SPG-Layout to generate physically plausible indoor scenes. The result is a more realistic and accurate 3D scene synthesis in complex environments.

IT Breakdown: Not directly applicable to IT infrastructure work, as it focuses on 3D indoor scene synthesis for architectural or design purposes rather than cloud infrastructure management.

item.title: Carolina Guide: A Multi-Agent RAG System with Institutional Guardrails for Academic Policy Assistance
item.description:
This research solves the problem of navigating complex academic policies by building a retrieval-augmented generation system called Carolina Guide. The system uses a multi-agent pipeline to provide accurate and institutionally compliant policy guidance. The result is a system that can efficiently assist university students with academic policy inquiries.

IT Breakdown: Not directly applicable to IT infrastructure work, as it focuses on a specific application of academic policy assistance and does not address general cloud infrastructure management.
